notes.title: Version 1.9.8
notes.content:
- Updated Unity Engine Version for improved performance and bug fixes
- Fixed Leaderboards not displaying data
- Major improvements to Ruins map graphics
- Improved graphics for Grove, Lava, and Spiral Maps

- Buffed Avenger creep AOE to 375
- Leaderboard now shows top 500
- Optimized image/sound compression

notes.title: Patch 1.9
notes.content:
[b]Usability:[/b]

- Clicking a tile deselects the current one
- Hold shift and click to multi-select tiles
- Hover over build icons to ghost in tower range and info
- Hover over upgrade icons fixed to do the same
- You can now see upgrades that are not available
- Zoom level adjusted

[b]Balance:[/b]

- Muck, Root, Nova, and Windstorm towers tweaked to 12%/28% slow from 10%/30%
- Corrosion tower buffed to 15%/45% damage increase from 12%/36%
- Incantation tower buffed to 18%/48% damage increase from 15%/45%
- Electricity tower buffed to 220/1100/5500 damage from 200/1000/5000
- Laser tower buffed to 200 area search range from 300
